meta.semantics: RETX-E: return-value STORE equivalence edges. Strict post-call EAX window (RETX-A semantics: forward until EAX overwritten / block boundary label-jmp-jcc-loop-ret / pushad / another call / 12 instructions; mov-copy extension max 2 tracked regs eax+1 copy, esp/ebp never). eax-mstore: dword store `mov [reg+off],<tracked>` with off!=0 and reg resolved to THIS — entry-ecx (cc thiscall|fastcall, undef-since-entry) or [ebp+8]/[ebp+arg_0] (fn_takes_this && cc not thiscall/fastcall), copy hops <=3, jt-label/jmp-bounded sound back-scan (dtc conventions) => EAX:FN:callsite == M:FN:this:0xOFF. eax-gstore: `mov [ds:]<global>,<tracked>` with global resolved via signals.json globals (name or pattern-global addr) => EAX == G:ADDR. Narrow stores (al/ax src, word/byte ptr dst, global struct member stru_X.f) skipped — width mismatch; 64-bit-return producers (CRT __allmul family / __int64 proto / EDX:EAX split-store companion `mov [base+off+4],edx`) skipped — same width-mismatch class (rule 4). Slot stores ([ebp-X]/[esp+X]/[ebp+arg]) skipped — slot_window/eax-flow eax-store territory. No cross-call tracking. Entity: EAX:<FN hex>:<callsite hex> (site=producer call addr).
